en.headline: Buildings Department files 259 charges over Wang Fuk Court renovation works
en.dek: Two companies and four individuals face summonses over alleged use of non-fire-retardant materials and failures to supervise repairs at the Tai Po estate where 168 died last November.
body: The Buildings Department on Wednesday laid a total of 259 charges against the project consultant, the main contractor and four individuals involved in major renovation works at Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po, the scene of a fire that killed 168 people and injured 79 in November 2025.

The department said the defendants are Will Power Architects Company Limited, Prestige Construction & Engineering Co., Limited, Will Power director Wong Hap-yin, registered inspector Ng Yeuk, and Prestige directors Hau Wa-kin and Ho Kin-yip. The summonses allege they permitted or authorised the use of defective or non-compliant materials, allowed works whose manner of execution caused injury and property damage, and failed to properly supervise prescribed repair works.

According to a government statement, investigation found that the registered inspector engaged by Will Power failed to properly supervise the prescribed repairs and ensure the buildings were safe. Will Power and Prestige are alleged to have permitted or authorised non-fire-retardant scaffolding nets and canvas, non-fire-retardant foam boards covering windows, and the removal of staircase fire-escape windows to create temporary openings later covered with non-fire-retardant material. Officials said those arrangements contributed to the rapid spread of the fire and hindered evacuation.

The department acted after a joint investigation with the Housing Bureau’s Independent Checking Unit. Prestige was earlier removed from the register of general building contractors. The defendants remain entitled to the presumption of innocence. Separate manslaughter, fraud and other charges were earlier brought by police and the Independent Commission Against Corruption.

zh.headline: 屋宇署就宏福苑維修工程提259項檢控
zh.dek: 兩公司及四人被控准許使用非阻燃物料及監督失當，涉去年11月大埔火災導致168人死亡的大維修工程。
body: 屋宇署周三就大埔宏福苑火災所涉大型樓宇維修工程，向工程顧問公司、總承建商及四名人士提出合共259項檢控。火災於2025年11月26日發生，造成168人死亡、79人受傷。
被起訴公司分別為鴻毅建築師有限公司及宏業建築工程有限公司，四人分別為鴻毅董事黃俠然、註冊檢驗人員吳躍，以及宏業董事侯華建和何建業。控罪包括涉嫌准許或授權使用欠妥或不符合《建築物條例》的物料、准許或授權進行導致傷亡及財產損毀的工程，以及沒有妥善監督修葺工程等。
政府發言人表示，調查顯示註冊檢驗人員沒有妥善監督訂明修葺及確保建築物安全；工程期間涉嫌准許使用非阻燃棚網及帆布、非阻燃發泡膠板遮擋窗戶，以及移除走火通道窗戶開設「生口」後以非阻燃物料掩蓋，令火勢迅速蔓延並阻礙逃生。
檢控是在屋宇署與房屋局獨立審查組聯合調查後提出。宏業早前已從註冊一般建築承建商名冊除名。被告仍享有無罪推定。警方及廉政公署早前已就相關人士及公司提出誤殺、串謀詐騙等控罪。
